expect.asks_about: The event date and venue to display.

item.title: Lantern Night Date and Venue

turns.text: Make an 8-second vertical promo for our Lantern Night, with glowing lanterns after dark. Put the date and venue big on screen so people know when and where to come. No voiceover.

item.tests: Checks that missing event details are requested and then rendered accurately as readable text in the finished promo.

answer_sheet.Event title and exact wording: Lantern Night; 14 November 2026; Willow Park, Bristol
answer_sheet.Visual style: Warm glowing lanterns outdoors after dark; other details are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: English text, no voiceover. Music or silence is your call.

must_haves: The delivered video is 8 seconds long and vertical 9:16.
'14 November 2026' and 'Willow Park, Bristol' appear clearly on screen together for at least 3 seconds.
Warm glowing lanterns are visible against an after-dark setting.

turns.text: Could you make a promo for our Lantern Night? I’m excited about the event and a little worried that the promo won’t get across how lovely it feels in person. What I’m after is an 8-second video in a vertical format. It should show glowing lanterns after dark. Please put the date and venue big on screen so people know when and where to come. I don’t want any voiceover.

dialog.agent:
Absolutely—we can aim for a warm, magical feel, with glowing lanterns against the night and gentle camera movement.

What **exact date and venue wording** should appear big on screen? And would you prefer **soft instrumental music, nighttime ambience, or silence**? No voiceover.
dialog.user: Please use “14 November 2026” and “Willow Park, Bristol” as the exact date and venue wording, both big on screen. Music or silence is your call, as long as there’s no voiceover. The event title should be “Lantern Night,” and all the on-screen text should be in English.

dialog.agent: What should move, and how (small natural motion, a slow push in, something happening)?
dialog.user: The movement is your call—whatever suits warm, glowing lanterns outdoors after dark. I’m mostly worried about getting across how lovely it feels in person, while keeping the date and venue big enough for people to know when and where to come. It’s an 8-second vertical 9:16 video, with no voiceover.

turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the promo because Magic Hour reported **insufficient credits**. No video was created.

The plan is ready: **8 seconds, vertical 9:16**, warm glowing lanterns with gentle movement, no sound or voiceover, and large English text:
- **Lantern Night**
- **14 November 2026**
- **Willow Park, Bristol**

This version needs approximately **202 credits**, including the starting image. Once credits are available, I can retry it.
